cross_checks.master_name: Lotus Thai Bistro (L76, 'official') and Lotus Thai Bistro Palo Alto Official (L650, 'official') - the same venue at 425 California Ave appears TWICE in the master list
cross_checks.what_the_fresh_capture_says: DUPLICATE MASTER ROWS CONFIRMED. Both L76 ('425 California Avenue, Palo Alto, CA') and L650 ('425 California Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94306') are the same restaurant; L76 carries no hours ('open Tuesday (hours of day not published)') while L650 carries 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM; 5:00 PM - 9:30 PM. A fresh Apple Maps capture for lotusthaibistro.com, +1 (650) 289-0907 shows Mon-Fri 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM and 5:00 PM - 9:30 PM, Sat 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM and 4:00 PM - 9:30 PM, Sun CLOSED - so L650's hours are corroborated and the Saturday dinner start is 4:00 PM, not 5:00 PM. The same Apple Maps page also renders a contradictory variant ('Mon-Sat 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM, 5:00 PM - 9:30 PM'). Recommend merging L76 into L650 in a future dedupe pass rather than adding a third row.
